newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK OF CYPRUS CUTS HOME RENOVATION LOAN BY 175 BPS.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF CYPRUS CUTS HOME RENOVATION LOAN BY 175 BPS.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus cut its home renovation loan rate by 175 basis points to 19 percent, it announced on Tuesday.
The home renovation loan is a flexible and fast solution for home improvement ideas and does not include any commission surcharge. Early retirement of the loan is not subject to any penalties.
Bank of Cyprus said these loans were available for amounts of one to five million drachmas with maturities up to 48 months. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
